book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: U Uꞌ TZꞌIBꞌAL BꞌENXEꞌ QꞌU HEBREO Hebreos U uꞌuj uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan te unqꞌa tiaal Israel uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Nim talchu u Jesús tiꞌ u Moisés

Estiꞌeꞌ, vitzꞌin vatzik, ex uvaꞌ ex itenam Tiixh, antu veꞌt oꞌ uvaꞌ kat imolo oꞌ u Tiixheꞌ setukꞌ tiꞌ qetzit u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ kꞌatz Aak. As qitzꞌataj setukꞌ tiꞌ u Jesucristo uvaꞌ chajel tzan tiꞌ kulochpeꞌ. As Aakeꞌ u nimla oksan tetz iyol tenam vatz u Tiixheꞌ, echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ chusel veꞌt sqaꞌn.
As kꞌujlebꞌal kꞌuꞌl u Jesucristo vatz u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ kan Aak. As ech kat ibꞌan u Moisés xoꞌl unqꞌa itenam u Tiixheꞌ, tan kꞌujlebꞌal chit kꞌuꞌl u Moisés vatz u tenameꞌ kat ibꞌana.
As at veꞌt pal toksal iqꞌii u Jesús tiꞌ u Moisés, echeꞌ tatin umaj lakol kabꞌal, tan at pal toksal iqꞌii tiꞌ u kabꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat ilaka.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa kabꞌaleꞌ, as at umaꞌl uxhchil lakol tetz. As aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ cheesan tetz skajayil.

As kꞌujlebꞌal kꞌuꞌl u Moisés vatz u Tiixheꞌ kat ibꞌana. As ech veꞌt tatin u Moisés echeꞌ umaj kꞌam tiꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ jankꞌal uvaꞌ kat tal u Tiixheꞌ ste as tiꞌ talat isuuchil kam uvaꞌ la tal u Tiixheꞌ xamtel.

As ech koj u Cristo, tan ech tatin Aakeꞌ xoꞌl vitenameꞌ echeꞌ umaj kꞌaol uvaꞌ ni ilon vikabꞌal vibꞌaaleꞌ. As oꞌeꞌ taꞌ uvaꞌ ech oꞌeꞌ ikabꞌal u Tiixheꞌ, asoj chabꞌamal qatin tiꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ nu kutxꞌebꞌeꞌ. As yeꞌ la yaꞌ oꞌ tiꞌ kuchiibꞌ stiꞌ, tul nu kutxꞌebꞌeꞌ.
Ni talpu te unqꞌa itenam u Tiixh uvaꞌ la ichabꞌa tatineꞌ tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ
Estiꞌeꞌ la val sete, tan ech la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixhla Espíritu, tan ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Asoj netabꞌi viyol u Tiixheꞌ cheel,
as yeꞌ la etiibꞌisa vetaanxelaleꞌ, echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ,
tul uvaꞌ kat ul veꞌt iviꞌ u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ,
tan nik isaꞌ tootzitaꞌ ma la ibꞌan Aak moj yeꞌle kam uvaꞌ kat tal Aak.

content: As estiꞌeꞌ ech kat tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ:

content.text: Tzitziꞌ kat isaꞌkat unqꞌa qꞌesla ebꞌaaleꞌ tootzitaꞌ ma an chit u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val ste moj yeꞌle.
As kꞌuxh kat til unqꞌa nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat unbꞌan stiꞌ tu kaꞌviinqil u yaabꞌeꞌ,
as nik isaꞌ tootzitaꞌ ma an chit u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val ste moj yeꞌle.
As estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ul veꞌt unviꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ atik tzitziꞌ.
As ech kat val veꞌt ileꞌ stiꞌ: «As tzꞌejxinal chit unqꞌa tenameꞌ tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ.
As yeꞌ nisaꞌ tootzit vuntxumbꞌaleꞌ,» chꞌin kat vala.
Estiꞌeꞌ kat vala uvaꞌ kat txꞌiꞌtziꞌl tu veꞌt in.
As kat unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ok veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tu u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ
uvaꞌ kat valtziꞌ ste uvaꞌ la chiibꞌ kat as uvaꞌ yeꞌ la bꞌuchlukat veꞌteꞌ, tiꞌk u Tiixhla Espíritu.

content: Atoj enachbꞌal, vitzꞌin vatzik, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaj ex la eteesa kan etibꞌ kꞌatz u islich Tiixheꞌ, as yeꞌ la etoksat etaama tiꞌ u vaꞌlexheꞌ, as tiꞌ iyansal vetxumbꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ Aak.
Pet aal la iyakꞌinsa tibꞌ etaama sevatzaj jun qꞌii tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ Aak. As ebꞌantaj cheel, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaj ex la etiibꞌisa etaama taꞌn u paaveꞌ uveꞌ ni tal imaxtibꞌet ex.
Tan asoj chabꞌamal qatin tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal kukꞌuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo techal tul Aak unpajte echeꞌ uvaꞌ nik kubꞌan sbꞌaxa, as at veꞌt qokebꞌal tiꞌ unqꞌa nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ la aqꞌax sqe taꞌn Aak.
As estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ech ni tal u yol ileꞌ:

content.text: Asoj netabꞌi viyol u Tiixheꞌ cheel,
as yeꞌ la etiibꞌisa vetaanxelaleꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ
tul uvaꞌ kat ul iviꞌ u Tiixheꞌ stiꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As tuk unnachonsa sete uvaꞌ ¿abꞌil kat abꞌin viyol u Tiixheꞌ as yeꞌ kat inima? Tan aꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ kat teqꞌo u Moisés bꞌey svatz tiꞌ tel chꞌuꞌl tu u Egipto.
¿As abꞌil stiꞌ kat ulkat iviꞌ u Tiixheꞌ tu kaꞌviinqil u yaabꞌeꞌ? Aꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ kat ipaasa tzii, as kat kamik kan tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
As unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni niman u yoleꞌ as kat kꞌujbꞌaꞌl veꞌt kan stiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ok tu u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl la bꞌuchlukat.
As nu kupal stuul uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat uch tetzit veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ kam uvaꞌ kat taltziꞌ veꞌt Aak ste, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak.
